sections.text_helper: Section 43.7.26 "LTDC layer x control register (LTDC_LxCR)" in chapter 43 (LCD-TFT display controller (LTDC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2135.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x10C+0x100*(x-1), (x = 1 to 2)
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:10 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 9 DCBEN: Default color blending enable
This bit is set and cleared by software.
0: Blending disabled
1: Blending enabled
Bit 8 HMEN: Horizontal mirroring enable
This bit is set and cleared by software.
0: Mirror disabled
1: Mirror enabled (if so, the color frame buffer start address has to be set to the last byte of
the first line, so for instance: if line is 100 pixels, 24bpp, then address is set to 299)
Bits 7:5 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 4 CLUTEN: Color look-up table enable
This bit is set and cleared by software.
0: Color look-up table disabled
1: Color look-up table enabled
The CLUT is only meaningful for L8, AL44 and AL88 pixel format.
Bits 3:2 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 1 CKEN: Color keying enable
This bit is set and cleared by software.
0: Color keying disabled
1: Color keying enabled: if RGB matches, then the ARGB are set to 0.
Bit 0 LEN: Layer enable
This bit is used to enable/disable the presence of this whole layer. it is set and cleared
bysoftware.
0: Layer disabled
1: Layer enabled
